properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.autoconfiguration.jackson.enabled
properties.description: If true, PageJacksonModule and SortJacksonModule bean will be provided for Jackson page decoding.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.circuitbreaker.alphanumeric-ids.enabled
properties.description: If true, Circuit Breaker ids will only contain alphanumeric characters to allow for configuration via configuration properties.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.circuitbreaker.enabled
properties.description: If true, an OpenFeign client will be wrapped with a Spring Cloud CircuitBreaker circuit breaker.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.circuitbreaker.group.enabled
properties.description: If true, an OpenFeign client will be wrapped with a Spring Cloud CircuitBreaker circuit breaker with group.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.client.decode-slash
properties.description: Feign clients do not encode slash `/` characters by default. To change this behavior, set the `decodeSlash` to `false`.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.client.refresh-enabled
properties.description: Enables options value refresh capability for Feign.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.client.remove-trailing-slash
properties.description: If {@code true}, trailing slashes at the end of request urls will be removed.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.compression.request.content-encoding-types
properties.description: The list of content encodings (applicable encodings depend on the used client).

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.compression.request.enabled
properties.description: Enables the request sent by Feign to be compressed.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.compression.request.mime-types
properties.description: The list of supported mime types.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.compression.request.min-request-size
properties.description: The minimum threshold content size.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.compression.response.enabled
properties.description: Enables the response from Feign to be compressed.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.encoder.charset-from-content-type
properties.description: Indicates whether the charset should be derived from the {@code Content-Type} header.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.http2client.enabled
properties.description: Enables the use of the Java11 HTTP 2 Client by Feign.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.connection-request-timeout
properties.description: Default value for connection request timeout.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.connection-request-timeout-unit
properties.description: Default value for connection request timeout unit.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.enabled
properties.description: Enables the use of the Apache HTTP Client 5 by Feign.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.pool-concurrency-policy
properties.description: Pool concurrency policies.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.pool-reuse-policy
properties.description: Pool connection re-use policies.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.socket-timeout
properties.description: Default value for socket timeout.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.hc5.socket-timeout-unit
properties.description: Default value for socket timeout unit.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.httpclient.http2.version
properties.description: Configure the protocols used by this client to communicate with remote servers. Uses {@link String} value of {@link HttpClient.Version}.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.lazy-attributes-resolution
properties.description: Switches @FeignClient attributes resolution mode to lazy.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.micrometer.enabled
properties.description: Enables Micrometer capabilities for Feign.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.oauth2.clientRegistrationId
properties.description: Provides a clientId to be used with OAuth2.

properties.name: spring.cloud.openfeign.oauth2.enabled
properties.description: Enables feign interceptor for managing oauth2 access token.
